referencePolicy: The inspected Hush Order plate controls family chassis, closed-loop cord topology, materials, palette, finish, and lighting. It is not permission to copy the representative's exact pose or form-specific cue. Each generation receives only that plate as the visual reference.
commonDirection: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: canonical individual bestiary production concept master for later 3D design. Render exactly one complete original Hush Order subject in a polished stylized 3D dark-fantasy MMORPG production style, three-quarter view, centered with generous clearance. Flat near-black neutral opaque studio backdrop; cold raking studio light; ungraded measurement-friendly presentation; no environment, abbey, floor, ground plane, pedestal, cast floor shadow, scene, extra creature, extra full-size person, caption, UI, logo, watermark, franchise resemblance, bright magic, aura, gore, exposed entrails, generic evil monk, mummy, wearable mask over a head, ordinary skeleton, or ordinary body under cloth. Family topology is mandatory and must remain visually traceable without occlusion: the skeleton is one and only one uninterrupted thick braided CLOSED-LOOP prayer cord. The same physical cord passes from an unmistakably EMPTY stitched linen head shell down the throat as a spine, out through the left shoulder and left arm, through the left wrist, across one low front loop, through the right wrist and right arm, back through the right shoulder, and closes at one clearly visible RETURN KNOT on the upper spine. No separate rope segments, hidden waist join, branching cord, cut cord, ordinary bones, flesh, torso, or conventional limbs inside the gaps. Linen is removed from chest, abdomen, shoulders, and inner arms, leaving broad black negative-space gaps around the cord. A restrained linen skirt and small shoulder panels hang only from sparse knots and never hide the route. The hollow head shell is open widely across its lower half into pure black vacancy, with the cord passing freely through it and no face-like volume behind its closed lid seams. Preserve composed opposing-foot stance, chalk linen, worn verdigris strips, bloodless gray extremities where form-specific canon requires them, salt-stiff cord, dry wax stitching, grounded frayed textile, restrained material density, absolute quiet, and no magical glow.
